scope: durable AI-chat tool approval, ambiguity detection, receipt reconciliation, and retry safety
invariants: approval-required tools enter a durable user-wait state before execution
consequential tool execution is conservatively marked potentially effectful before handler execution
in-doubt durable reservations are never blindly replayed
no-effect retry requires explicit durable reconciliation evidence
committed reconciliation requires a canonical matching tool receipt
reconciliation evidence is incident-scoped and cannot unlock a later reservation
committed executions cannot be reconciled as no-effect
turn events record reconciliation evidence separately from tool receipts
canonical and AI-runtime tool receipt stores are byte-identical
promotion_rule: implemented candidate only; exact-head regression and independent verification must pass before qualification
